Interface PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver

All Superinterfaces:
PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache
All Known Implementing Classes:
AggregateMemberResolver, NonCachingMemberDimensionCache, PropertiesKnownInvalidMemberResolver, PropertiesMemberDimensionCache
Enclosing interface:

public static interface PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver extends PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache
An elaboration of the PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache that offers more sophistication than just resolving the dimension for a given member.

  • Method Details

    • getMember

      PbcsMember getMember(PbcsPlanType planType, String memberOrAliasName)
      Gets a member from this resolver for the given plan type and a requested member or alias name. It is up to the implementing provider to decide if it wants to lowercase or otherwise transform the name. If the member is not resolved, the requesting plan will attempt to resolve it and then call setMember(PbcsPlanType, String, PbcsMember) with the member details.
      Parameters:
      planType - the plan type that the member is being requested from. Implementors will likely need/want to use this information to build a unique caching key that can be used in generic cache implementation.
      memberOrAliasName - the member or alias name being looked up
      Returns:
      the member, if found, null otherwise, indicating that the member is not in the resolver (cache) and the plan should attempt to resolve on its own (and then update the cache via setMember(PbcsPlanType, String, PbcsMember)).
